title: The Real Cost of Skipping Gap Insurance After a Totaled Car

scenes.text: Totally wrecked a $25k car with no gap coverage?
scenes.query: totaled car without gap insurance cost

scenes.label: LOAN BALANCE EXCEEDS TRADE‑IN VALUE
scenes.text: Most auto loans leave you owing more than the car’s market value once it’s totaled.
scenes.query: auto loan balance higher than trade‑in value

scenes.label: GAP INSURANCE COVERS DIFFERENCE
scenes.text: Gap insurance pays the gap between what you owe and the insurance payout, often saving thousands.
scenes.query: gap insurance pays difference loan vs payout
scenes.query2: gap coverage saves money after total loss

scenes.label: AVERAGE GAP COST IS $400‑$600 YEARLY
scenes.text: Industry data shows typical gap coverage costs between $400 and $600 per year, a fraction of a potential loss.
scenes.query: average cost of gap insurance per year

description: Skipping gap insurance can leave you footing a huge bill after a total loss. Learn why a modest yearly premium protects you from a thousand‑dollar surprise. Follow for practical car‑finance tips!
